prior_year_events.event_name: RITC from Syndicate 1955 into 2018 (2017 Year of Account Reinsured to Close)
prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2017 year of account has Reinsured to close ("RITC") into the Syndicate's 2018 Year of Account for an RITC premium of GBP 66.5m. Under Lloyd's Accounting rules, the Syndicate's 2017 year of account closed at the end of 2019, with a return equal to 7.35% loss.

named_events.loss_description: adversely impacted the Syndicate's planned profit by GBP 7.0m
adversely impacted the Syndicate's planned profit by GBP 7.0m

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate discloses opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 185.769m at 1 January 2019. The annual report does not provide an explicit aggregate GROSS prior year reserve movement figure in the movement note; a gross claims development triangle is present but the report notes a RITC (2017 into 2018) which distorts development comparisons. The managing agent highlights natural catastrophe activity in 2019 (notably Typhoons Faxai and Hagibis which adversely impacted planned profit by GBP 7.0m) and RITC activity related to 2017/2018. Because no clear gross prior-year movement is provided and RITC materially affects the triangle, an authoritative gross prior year development amount cannot be determined from the report.
raw_causal_phrases: Typhoons Faxai and Hagibis adversely impacted the Syndicate's planned profit by GBP 7.0m.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit aggregate GROSS prior year reserve movement is stated in the movement note. A gross claims development triangle is present but the report discloses a material RITC (2017 into 2018) which distorts the triangle; therefore the triangle was judged unreliable as a primary source and no definitive gross prior year development amount is reported. Where figures are cited they are from the statutory notes (all amounts in the notes are presented in GBP 7000).
